label: D1 after an unrewarded visit to S2
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO/D2), and essentially only when the previous trial ended unrewarded in state S2 (prev_state != 1 also admits the window-first trial whose previous state is outside the window; prev_state == 2 alone gives dev P 0.76 / R 0.80 / F1 0.78 but loses those). Every dev activation after an unrewarded trial had prev_state S2 or unknown; it almost never fires after reward (1.4% of mass) or after unrewarded S1. This is model-based evidence that S1 is good (S2 unrewarded), and the unit is more active when the agent then leans to a1 (policy logit > 0: precision 0.87 but recall drops) and when S1 is truly good. Activation rate and magnitude grow across the episode (trial 0-9 rate 0.017 vs 90-99 0.081) and with low value. Precision is incomplete (~0.65 dev): many unrewarded-S2 D1 steps stay below threshold, mostly when the agent has been persistently choosing a2/S2 is good. Dev: P 0.65, R 0.96, F1 0.77, mass recall 0.99.
